about.title: About Towers Real Estate
body: Towers Real Estate advises buyers and investors on property in Oman.

faq.q: Are the prices and availability on this site?
faq.a: Not yet. The developer confirms prices and availability. Ask us and we will pass the question on.

faq.q: Can foreigners buy property in Oman?
faq.a: The published rules changed in 2026 (Decision No. 87/2026). Sources differ on which areas are open to foreign buyers. Please check with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning and your own adviser before you commit.

faq.q: Does owning property give a residence visa?
faq.a: Under the published framework, some owners of registered residential units can apply for a residence permit without a sponsor. Eligibility conditions apply, so please confirm them with an adviser.

faq.q: Is this site an official developer site?
faq.a: No. Towers Real Estate is a separate company. The renders are the developer's, credited on each image.

split.title: Wadi Zaha, Sultan Haitham City
body: Wadi Zaha is a residential and mixed-use development in Sultan Haitham City, Muscat, by Al Ahly Sabbour. The developer describes the Iconic Tower as the first and tallest tower in the city, with a hotel and serviced apartments.
Construction began on 9 February 2026, according to Omnia Capital Group. Completion is given as early 2028; the sources differ on the month.
points: Completion: early 2028 (sources differ on the month)

statement.text: We help buyers and investors understand a property before they commit: the facts, the sources, and what is still unconfirmed.

items.title: Wadi Zaha
items.text: Studios to four-bedroom homes in a mixed-use development by Al Ahly Sabbour, including a hotel in the Iconic Tower.

items.title: The Sustainable City – Yiti
items.text: Villas, apartments and beachfront residences in a master-planned sustainable city of nearly one million square metres.

detail.intro: The Sustainable City – Yiti is a master-planned city on the Gulf of Oman by Diamond Developers, a subsidiary of SEE Holding, in collaboration with OMRAN Group. Three neighbourhoods share one plan: Sustainable District villas, The Plaza apartments, and The Arc serviced residences.
points: Schools, clinics and a mosque within walking distance
The Plaza: 70 retail and dining outlets
Beachfront and marina, with a resident-only mooring at The Arc
Solar generation designed to cover the city's own demand (developer's stated design)
Zero annual service fees for Sustainable District villa owners (developer's stated policy)

facts.label: Developer
facts.value: Diamond Developers (SEE Holding), with OMRAN Group

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Yiti, on the Gulf of Oman

facts.label: Handover
facts.value: The Plaza: December 2027, confirmed by the developer. City completion: 'by the end of 2026' in the launch release. Confirm with the developer
